topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Run of the mill Tuesday, and in walks a dame, says she's got a problem. Flowers on her doorstep this morning, no note, no nothing. I ask her, what's the world coming to when a lady can't get a decent delivery? Must be a mix-up, I tell her, but she's not buying it. Says there's something more to it, eyes wide, like she's seen a ghost. I lean back, light up a smoke, and give her the once-over. Could be an admirer, I say, or could be someone thumbing their nose at her. World's full of pricks with nothing better to do. She doesn't like that answer, but what else is there? Guess I'll take the case, dig up some dirt, see what sticks. But I got a hunch this ain't gonna be pretty.
